gasohol.definition: n. a gasoline substitute consisting of 90% gasoline and 10% grain alcohol from corn
gasohol.translation: n. 酒精-汽油混合燃料

gasohole.translation: (=gasoline + alcohol)汽油和酒精的混合燃料

gasol.translation: 石油气冷凝物, 气态碳氢化合物, 液化石油气

gasolene.definition: n a volatile flammable mixture of hydrocarbons (hexane and heptane and octane etc.) derived from petroleum; used mainly as a fuel in internal-combustion engines

gasoline.definition: n. a volatile flammable mixture of hydrocarbons (hexane and heptane and octane etc.) derived from petroleum; used mainly as a fuel in internal-combustion engines

gasoline corrosion test cup.translation: [化] 汽油试蚀杯; 汽油腐蚀试验杯

gasoline engine.translation: [化] 汽油机; 汽油发动机

gasoline gage dial.translation: [化] 汽油表标度板; 汽油表标度盘

gasoline gauge dial.translation: [化] 汽油表标度板; 汽油表标度盘

gasoline gumming test cup.translation: [化] 汽油试胶杯; 汽油胶质测定杯

gasoline mileage.translation: [化] 汽油里程(每加仑汽油行驶的距离,英里)

gasoline pool.translation: [化] (炼厂)汽油调合组分总和(将不同质量汽油掺合成一定规格的产品汽油)

gasolines.definition: n. a volatile flammable mixture of hydrocarbons (hexane and heptane and octane etc.) derived from petroleum; used mainly as a fuel in internal-combustion engines
gasolines.translation: n. 汽油( gasoline的复数形式 )

gasometer.definition:
n a meter for measuring the amount of gas flowing through a particular pipe
n a large gas-tight spherical or cylindrical tank for holding gas to be used as fuel
gasometer.translation:
n. 储气器, 煤气筒, 气体计量器
[医] 气量计, 气体定量器

gasometers.definition:
n. a meter for measuring the amount of gas flowing through a particular pipe
n. a large gas-tight spherical or cylindrical tank for holding gas to be used as fuel
gasometers.translation: n. 贮气器, （储）煤气柜( gasometer的复数形式 )

gasometric.translation: a. [化]气体定量分析的,气体定量分析学(或分析法)的

gasometric analysis.translation:
[化] 气体分析; 气体定量分析
[医] 气体分析法

gasometrical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the measurement of gases; as,
   gasometric analysis.
gasometrical.translation: a. 气体定量分析的, 气体定量分析学（或分析法）的

gasometry.definition:
n. The art or practice of measuring gases; also, the
   science which treats of the nature and properties of these elastic
   fluids.

gasoscope.definition:
n. An apparatus for detecting the presence of any dangerous
   gas, from a gas leak in a coal mine or a dwelling house.

gasotron.translation: 充气管整流器, 气体整流器
